question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (1)
solution:
The correct answer is: **visit**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"visit"** means to go to see and spend time with (someone) socially.; trip (मुलाकात करना)

 
 
• **Example:** I plan to visit my grandparents this weekend.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that the President greeted the Italian Prime Minister warmly on her first trip to India
